170	    count = 0

180	    """Map a path to its canonical form in all_py_files via suffix matching."""
181	    if path in all_py_files:
182	        return path
183	    for f in all_py_files:
184	        if f.endswith("/" + path) or path.endswith("/" + f):
185	            return f

187	    candidates = [f for f in all_py_files if os.path.basename(f) == basename]

192	    for f in candidates:

194	        if score > best_score:

204	def beniget_extract(repo_path: str, buggy_file: str, buggy_function: str) -> dict:
205	    """
206	    Intra-file def-use chain extraction via beniget.
207	    Returns a dict with call_graph (empty) and dataflow_paths (intra-file only).
208	    """
209	    try:
210	        import beniget
211	    except ImportError:
212	        log.error("beniget not installed; pip install beniget")
213	        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}
214	
215	    resolved = resolve_file_in_repo(repo_path, buggy_file)
216	    if resolved:
217	        buggy_file = resolved
218	    target_path = os.path.join(repo_path, buggy_file)
219	    if not os.path.exists(target_path):
220	        log.warning("Buggy file not found: %s", target_path)
221	        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}
222	
223	    try:
224	        with open(target_path) as f:
225	            source = f.read()
226	        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=buggy_file)
227	    except SyntaxError:
228	        log.warning("SyntaxError parsing %s", target_path)
229	        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}
230	
231	    duc = beniget.DefUseChains()
232	    duc.visit(tree)
233	
234	    # Build def-use edges within the buggy file
235	    dataflow_paths = []
236	    buggy_func_node = None
237	    for node in ast.walk(tree):
238	        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
239	            if node.name == buggy_function:
240	                buggy_func_node = node
241	                break
242	
243	    if buggy_func_node is None:
244	        log.warning("Function %s not found in %s", buggy_function, buggy_file)
245	        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}
246	
247	    # Collect all names defined in the buggy function and trace their uses
248	    for node in ast.walk(buggy_func_node):
249	        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
250	            try:
251	                chain = duc.chains[node]
252	            except KeyError:
253	                continue
254	            for user in chain.users():
255	                user_node = user.node
256	                dataflow_paths.append({
257	                    "source_file": buggy_file,
258	                    "source_func": buggy_function,
259	                    "source_line": getattr(node, "lineno", 0),
260	                    "sink_file": buggy_file,
261	                    "sink_func": _enclosing_function_name(tree, user_node),
262	                    "sink_line": getattr(user_node, "lineno", 0),
263	                    "path_length": 1,
264	                })
265	
266	    # Deduplicate
267	    seen = set()
268	    unique = []
269	    for p in dataflow_paths:
270	        key = (p["source_func"], p["source_line"], p["sink_func"], p["sink_line"])
271	        if key not in seen:
272	            seen.add(key)
273	            unique.append(p)
274	
275	    return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": unique}

278	def _enclosing_function_name(tree: ast.AST, node: ast.AST) -> str:
279	    """Find the name of the function enclosing `node`, or '<module>'."""
280	    # Build parent map
281	    parent_map: dict[ast.AST, ast.AST] = {}
282	    for parent in ast.walk(tree):
283	        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(parent):
284	            parent_map[child] = parent
285	    current = node
286	    while current in parent_map:
287	        current = parent_map[current]
288	        if isinstance(current, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
289	            return current.name
290	    return "<module>"

99	        "dataflow_path_count": float(path_count),
100	        "dependency_type": dep_type,

106	def normalize_features(instances: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
107	    """Min-max normalize feature vectors across all instances."""
108	    if not instances:
109	        return instances
110	
111	    keys = ["dataflow_distance", "dataflow_path_count", "bm25_score"]
112	    all_features = []
113	    for inst in instances:
114	        all_features.append(inst["features"])
115	        for neg in inst.get("neg_features", []):
116	            all_features.append(neg)
117	
118	    mins = {k: float("inf") for k in keys}
119	    maxs = {k: float("-inf") for k in keys}
120	    for feat in all_features:
121	        for k in keys:
122	            v = feat.get(k, 0.0)
123	            mins[k] = min(mins[k], v)
124	            maxs[k] = max(maxs[k], v)
125	
126	    def norm(feat: dict) -> dict:
127	        out = dict(feat)
128	        for k in keys:
129	            rng = maxs[k] - mins[k]
130	            if rng > 0:
131	                out[k] = (out[k] - mins[k]) / rng
132	            else:
133	                out[k] = 0.0
134	        return out
135	
136	    for inst in instances:
137	        inst["features"] = norm(inst["features"])
138	        inst["neg_features"] = [norm(nf) for nf in inst.get("neg_features", [])]
139	
140	    return instances

147	def sample_negatives(
148	    query: str,
149	    positive_files: set[str],
150	    connected_files: set[str],
151	    all_files: list[str],
152	    file_contents: dict[str, str],
153	    bm25_index,

155	    hard_negative_ratio: float,
156	) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
157	    """
158	    Sample negatives with a mix of strategies:
159	    - hard_negative_ratio fraction: BM25-similar but structurally disconnected
160	    - remaining: random from repo
161	
162	    Returns (neg_file_paths, neg_strategies).
163	    """
164	    candidate_pool = [
165	        f for f in all_files
166	        if f not in positive_files and f in file_contents
167	    ]
168	    if not candidate_pool:
169	        return [], []
170	
171	    num_hard = int(num_negatives * hard_negative_ratio)
172	    num_random = num_negatives - num_hard
173	
174	    neg_files = []
175	    neg_strategies = []
176	
177	    # Hard negatives: high BM25 but NOT in connected_files
178	    if num_hard > 0 and bm25_index is not None:
179	        disconnected = [f for f in candidate_pool if f not in connected_files]
180	        if disconnected:
181	            scores = bm25_scores(bm25_index, query)
182	            file_to_idx = {f: i for i, f in enumerate(all_files)}
183	            scored = [
184	                (f, scores[file_to_idx[f]])
185	                for f in disconnected
186	                if f in file_to_idx and file_to_idx[f] < len(scores)
187	            ]
188	            scored.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
189	            for f, _ in scored[:num_hard]:
190	                neg_files.append(f)
191	                neg_strategies.append("bm25_hard")
192	
193	    # Random negatives
194	    remaining_pool = [f for f in candidate_pool if f not in set(neg_files)]
195	    if remaining_pool and num_random > 0:
196	        sample_size = min(num_random, len(remaining_pool))
197	        for f in random.sample(remaining_pool, sample_size):
198	            neg_files.append(f)
199	            neg_strategies.append("random")
200	
201	    return neg_files[:num_negatives], neg_strategies[:num_negatives]

242	                )
243

245	    for cg in extraction.get("call_graph", []):

261	        }

264	    positive_files = set(connected_files.keys())

267	    char_count = 0
268	    for fpath, info in sorted(connected_files.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["min_path_length"]):
269	        content = file_contents.get(fpath)

284	        query, positive_files, set(connected_files.keys()),
285	        all_files, file_contents, bm25_index,
286	        num_negatives, hard_negative_ratio,
287	    )

289	    neg_codes = []

293	        content = file_contents.get(nf, "")

302	    return {
303	        "instance_id": extraction.get("instance_id", ""),

306	        "neg_codes": neg_codes,
307	        "features": pos_features,

Output: JSONL files in output_dir, one per repo, plus merged all.jsonl

Dependencies: codeql CLI on PATH, beniget (pip install beniget)
"""

import argparse
import json
import logging
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from multiprocessing import Pool
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import ast

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s",
)
log = logging.getLogger("extract_dataflow")

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CALL_GRAPH_QL = SCRIPT_DIR / "codeql_queries" / "call_graph.ql"
DATAFLOW_QL = SCRIPT_DIR / "codeql_queries" / "bounded_dataflow.ql"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CodeQL helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_codeql_database(repo_path: str, db_path: str, timeout: int) -> bool:
    """Create a CodeQL database for a Python repo. Returns True on success."""
    cmd = [
        "codeql", "database", "create", db_path,
        "--language=python",
        "--source-root", repo_path,
        "--overwrite",
        "--threads=0",  # use all available cores
    ]
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=True
        )
        return True
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:
        log.warning("CodeQL database creation failed for %s: %s", repo_path, e)
        return False


def run_codeql_query(
    db_path: str,
    query_path: str,
    output_csv: str,
    buggy_function: str,
    buggy_file: str,
    timeout: int,
    ram: int,
) -> bool:
    """Run a CodeQL query with external predicates. Returns True on success."""
    cmd = [
        "codeql", "query", "run",
        "--database", db_path,
        "--output", output_csv,
        "--format=csv",
        f"--ram={ram}",
        f"--timeout={timeout}",
        f"--external=buggyFunctionName={buggy_function}",
        f"--external=buggyFileName={buggy_file}",
        "--threads=0",
        query_path,
    ]
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout + 60, check=True
        )
        return True
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:
        log.warning("CodeQL query failed (%s): %s", query_path, e)
        return False


def parse_call_graph_csv(csv_path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse call_graph.ql CSV output into list of function records."""
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("target_func"):
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 6:
                results.append({
                    "target_func": parts[0],
                    "hop_distance": int(parts[1]),
                    "direction": parts[2],
                    "file_path": parts[3],
                    "start_line": int(parts[4]),
                    "end_line": int(parts[5]),
                })
    return results


def parse_dataflow_csv(csv_path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse bounded_dataflow.ql CSV output into list of flow records."""
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("source_file"):
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 7:
                results.append({
                    "source_file": parts[0],
                    "source_func": parts[1],
                    "source_line": int(parts[2]) if parts[2].isdigit() else 0,
                    "sink_file": parts[3],
                    "sink_func": parts[4],
                    "sink_line": int(parts[5]) if parts[5].isdigit() else 0,
                    "path_length": int(parts[6]) if parts[6].isdigit() else 1,
                })
    return results


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Path normalization
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def resolve_file_in_repo(repo_path: str, target_file: str) -> str | None:
    """Resolve a file path against a repo, handling src/ prefix mismatches."""
    candidate = os.path.join(repo_path, target_file)
    if os.path.exists(candidate):
        return target_file

    basename = os.path.basename(target_file)
    best_match = None
    best_suffix_len = 0
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(repo_path):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".") and d != "__pycache__"]
        for f in files:
            if f == basename:
                rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), repo_path)
                if rel.endswith(target_file):
                    return rel
                suffix_len = _common_suffix_length(rel, target_file)
                if suffix_len > best_suffix_len:
                    best_suffix_len = suffix_len
                    best_match = rel
    return best_match


def _common_suffix_length(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    a_parts = a.split("/")
    b_parts = b.split("/")
    count = 0
    for ap, bp in zip(reversed(a_parts), reversed(b_parts)):
        if ap == bp:
            count += 1
        else:
            break
    return count


def normalize_path(path: str, all_py_files: list[str]) -> str:
    """Map a path to its canonical form in all_py_files via suffix matching."""
    if path in all_py_files:
        return path
    for f in all_py_files:
        if f.endswith("/" + path) or path.endswith("/" + f):
            return f
    basename = os.path.basename(path)
    candidates = [f for f in all_py_files if os.path.basename(f) == basename]
    if len(candidates) == 1:
        return candidates[0]
    path_parts = path.split("/")
    best, best_score = path, 0
    for f in candidates:
        score = _common_suffix_length(f, path)
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best = f
    return best if best_score > 0 else path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Beniget fallback
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def beniget_extract(repo_path: str, buggy_file: str, buggy_function: str) -> dict:
    """
    Intra-file def-use chain extraction via beniget.
    Returns a dict with call_graph (empty) and dataflow_paths (intra-file only).
    """
    try:
        import beniget
    except ImportError:
        log.error("beniget not installed; pip install beniget")
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    resolved = resolve_file_in_repo(repo_path, buggy_file)
    if resolved:
        buggy_file = resolved
    target_path = os.path.join(repo_path, buggy_file)
    if not os.path.exists(target_path):
        log.warning("Buggy file not found: %s", target_path)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    try:
        with open(target_path) as f:
            source = f.read()
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=buggy_file)
    except SyntaxError:
        log.warning("SyntaxError parsing %s", target_path)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    duc = beniget.DefUseChains()
    duc.visit(tree)

    # Build def-use edges within the buggy file
    dataflow_paths = []
    buggy_func_node = None
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            if node.name == buggy_function:
                buggy_func_node = node
                break

    if buggy_func_node is None:
        log.warning("Function %s not found in %s", buggy_function, buggy_file)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    # Collect all names defined in the buggy function and trace their uses
    for node in ast.walk(buggy_func_node):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            try:
                chain = duc.chains[node]
            except KeyError:
                continue
            for user in chain.users():
                user_node = user.node
                dataflow_paths.append({
                    "source_file": buggy_file,
                    "source_func": buggy_function,
                    "source_line": getattr(node, "lineno", 0),
                    "sink_file": buggy_file,
                    "sink_func": _enclosing_function_name(tree, user_node),
                    "sink_line": getattr(user_node, "lineno", 0),
                    "path_length": 1,
                })

    # Deduplicate
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for p in dataflow_paths:
        key = (p["source_func"], p["source_line"], p["sink_func"], p["sink_line"])
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(p)

    return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": unique}


def _enclosing_function_name(tree: ast.AST, node: ast.AST) -> str:
    """Find the name of the function enclosing `node`, or '<module>'."""
    # Build parent map
    parent_map: dict[ast.AST, ast.AST] = {}
    for parent in ast.walk(tree):
        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(parent):
            parent_map[child] = parent
    current = node
    while current in parent_map:
        current = parent_map[current]
        if isinstance(current, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            return current.name
    return "<module>"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-repo processing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def process_repo(args_tuple: tuple) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """
    Process a single repo: CodeQL extraction with Beniget fallback.
    Called by multiprocessing pool.
    """
    instance, codeql_timeout, codeql_ram, min_reachable_files = args_tuple
    repo_path = instance["repo_path"]
    buggy_file = instance["buggy_file"]
    buggy_function = instance["buggy_function"]
    instance_id = instance.get("instance_id", os.path.basename(repo_path))

    log.info("Processing %s: %s in %s", instance_id, buggy_function, buggy_file)
    start = time.time()

    result = {
        "instance_id": instance_id,
        "repo_path": repo_path,
        "buggy_file": buggy_file,
        "buggy_function": buggy_function,
        "inter_procedural": False,
        "extraction_method": "none",
        "call_graph": [],
        "dataflow_paths": [],
        "extraction_time_s": 0.0,
        "error": None,
    }

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="structfuse_") as tmpdir:
        db_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "codeql_db")
        cg_csv = os.path.join(tmpdir, "call_graph.csv")
        df_csv = os.path.join(tmpdir, "dataflow.csv")

        # Phase 1a: CodeQL database + call graph
        codeql_ok = False
        if create_codeql_database(repo_path, db_path, timeout=codeql_timeout):
            if run_codeql_query(
                db_path, str(CALL_GRAPH_QL), cg_csv,
                buggy_function, buggy_file, codeql_timeout, codeql_ram,
            ):
                call_graph = parse_call_graph_csv(cg_csv)
                reachable_files = len({r["file_path"] for r in call_graph})

                if reachable_files >= min_reachable_files:
                    # Phase 1b: bounded data-flow
                    if run_codeql_query(
                        db_path, str(DATAFLOW_QL), df_csv,
                        buggy_function, buggy_file, codeql_timeout, codeql_ram,
                    ):
                        dataflow_paths = parse_dataflow_csv(df_csv)
                        result["call_graph"] = call_graph
                        result["dataflow_paths"] = dataflow_paths
                        result["inter_procedural"] = True
                        result["extraction_method"] = "codeql"
                        codeql_ok = True
                    else:
                        log.warning(
                            "%s: data-flow query failed/timed out, falling back",
                            instance_id,
                        )
                else:
                    log.info(
                        "%s: only %d reachable files (min %d), falling back",
                        instance_id, reachable_files, min_reachable_files,
                    )

        # Beniget fallback
        if not codeql_ok:
            log.info("%s: using Beniget fallback", instance_id)
            beniget_result = beniget_extract(repo_path, buggy_file, buggy_function)
            result["call_graph"] = beniget_result["call_graph"]
            result["dataflow_paths"] = beniget_result["dataflow_paths"]
            result["inter_procedural"] = False
            result["extraction_method"] = "beniget"

    result["extraction_time_s"] = round(time.time() - start, 2)
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="StructFuse Stage 1: extract data-flow features per repo"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repos-file", required=True, help="JSON list of instances")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True, help="Output directory for JSONL")
    parser.add_argument("--num-workers", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--codeql-timeout", type=int, default=300, help="Seconds")
    parser.add_argument("--codeql-ram", type=int, default=8192, help="MB")
    parser.add_argument("--min-reachable-files", type=int, default=5)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    with open(args.repos_file) as f:
        instances = json.load(f)
    log.info("Loaded %d instances", len(instances))

    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    task_args = [
        (inst, args.codeql_timeout, args.codeql_ram, args.min_reachable_files)
        for inst in instances
    ]

    results: list[dict] = []
    if args.num_workers <= 1:
        for ta in task_args:
            r = process_repo(ta)
            if r:
                results.append(r)
    else:
        with Pool(processes=args.num_workers) as pool:
            for r in pool.imap_unordered(process_repo, task_args):
                if r:
                    results.append(r)

    # Write per-instance JSONL
    merged_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "all.jsonl")
    with open(merged_path, "w") as fout:
        for r in results:
            fout.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    # Statistics
    total = len(results)
    codeql_count = sum(1 for r in results if r["extraction_method"] == "codeql")
    beniget_count = sum(1 for r in results if r["extraction_method"] == "beniget")
    failed_count = sum(1 for r in results if r["extraction_method"] == "none")
    avg_time = sum(r["extraction_time_s"] for r in results) / max(total, 1)
    inter_proc = sum(1 for r in results if r["inter_procedural"])

    log.info("=" * 60)
    log.info("Extraction complete: %d instances", total)
    log.info("  CodeQL success:  %d (%.1f%%)", codeql_count, 100 * codeql_count / max(total, 1))
    log.info("  Beniget fallback:%d (%.1f%%)", beniget_count, 100 * beniget_count / max(total, 1))
    log.info("  Failed:          %d (%.1f%%)", failed_count, 100 * failed_count / max(total, 1))
    log.info("  Inter-procedural:%d (%.1f%%)", inter_proc, 100 * inter_proc / max(total, 1))
    log.info("  Avg time/repo:   %.1fs", avg_time)
    log.info("  Output: %s", merged_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def create_codeql_database(repo_path: str, db_path: str, timeout: int) -> bool:
    """Create a CodeQL database for a Python repo. Returns True on success."""
    cmd = [
        "codeql", "database", "create", db_path,
        "--language=python",
        "--source-root", repo_path,
        "--overwrite",
        "--threads=0",  # use all available cores
    ]
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=True
        )
        return True
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:
        log.warning("CodeQL database creation failed for %s: %s", repo_path, e)
        return False


def run_codeql_query(
    db_path: str,
    query_path: str,
    output_csv: str,
    buggy_function: str,
    buggy_file: str,
    timeout: int,
    ram: int,
) -> bool:
    """Run a CodeQL query with external predicates. Returns True on success."""
    cmd = [
        "codeql", "query", "run",
        "--database", db_path,
        "--output", output_csv,
        "--format=csv",
        f"--ram={ram}",
        f"--timeout={timeout}",
        f"--external=buggyFunctionName={buggy_function}",
        f"--external=buggyFileName={buggy_file}",
        "--threads=0",
        query_path,
    ]
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout + 60, check=True
        )
        return True
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:
        log.warning("CodeQL query failed (%s): %s", query_path, e)
        return False


def parse_call_graph_csv(csv_path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse call_graph.ql CSV output into list of function records."""
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("target_func"):
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 6:
                results.append({
                    "target_func": parts[0],
                    "hop_distance": int(parts[1]),
                    "direction": parts[2],
                    "file_path": parts[3],
                    "start_line": int(parts[4]),
                    "end_line": int(parts[5]),
                })
    return results


def parse_dataflow_csv(csv_path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse bounded_dataflow.ql CSV output into list of flow records."""
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("source_file"):
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 7:
                results.append({
                    "source_file": parts[0],
                    "source_func": parts[1],
                    "source_line": int(parts[2]) if parts[2].isdigit() else 0,
                    "sink_file": parts[3],
                    "sink_func": parts[4],
                    "sink_line": int(parts[5]) if parts[5].isdigit() else 0,
                    "path_length": int(parts[6]) if parts[6].isdigit() else 1,
                })
    return results


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Beniget fallback
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def beniget_extract(repo_path: str, buggy_file: str, buggy_function: str) -> dict:
    """
    Intra-file def-use chain extraction via beniget.
    Returns a dict with call_graph (empty) and dataflow_paths (intra-file only).
    """
    try:
        import beniget
    except ImportError:
        log.error("beniget not installed; pip install beniget")
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    target_path = os.path.join(repo_path, buggy_file)
    if not os.path.exists(target_path):
        log.warning("Buggy file not found: %s", target_path)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    try:
        with open(target_path) as f:
            source = f.read()
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=buggy_file)
    except SyntaxError:
        log.warning("SyntaxError parsing %s", target_path)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    duc = beniget.DefUseChains()
    duc.visit(tree)

    # Build def-use edges within the buggy file
    dataflow_paths = []
    buggy_func_node = None
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            if node.name == buggy_function:
                buggy_func_node = node
                break

    if buggy_func_node is None:
        log.warning("Function %s not found in %s", buggy_function, buggy_file)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    # Collect all names defined in the buggy function and trace their uses
    for node in ast.walk(buggy_func_node):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            try:
                chain = duc.chains[node]
            except KeyError:
                continue
            for user in chain.users():
                user_node = user.node
                dataflow_paths.append({
                    "source_file": buggy_file,
                    "source_func": buggy_function,
                    "source_line": getattr(node, "lineno", 0),
                    "sink_file": buggy_file,
                    "sink_func": _enclosing_function_name(tree, user_node),
                    "sink_line": getattr(user_node, "lineno", 0),
                    "path_length": 1,
                })

    # Deduplicate
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for p in dataflow_paths:
        key = (p["source_func"], p["source_line"], p["sink_func"], p["sink_line"])
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(p)

    return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": unique}


def _enclosing_function_name(tree: ast.AST, node: ast.AST) -> str:
    """Find the name of the function enclosing `node`, or '<module>'."""
    # Build parent map
    parent_map: dict[ast.AST, ast.AST] = {}
    for parent in ast.walk(tree):
        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(parent):
            parent_map[child] = parent
    current = node
    while current in parent_map:
        current = parent_map[current]
        if isinstance(current, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            return current.name
    return "<module>"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-repo processing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def process_repo(args_tuple: tuple) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """
    Process a single repo: CodeQL extraction with Beniget fallback.
    Called by multiprocessing pool.
    """
    instance, codeql_timeout, codeql_ram, min_reachable_files = args_tuple
    repo_path = instance["repo_path"]
    buggy_file = instance["buggy_file"]
    buggy_function = instance["buggy_function"]
    instance_id = instance.get("instance_id", os.path.basename(repo_path))

    log.info("Processing %s: %s in %s", instance_id, buggy_function, buggy_file)
    start = time.time()

    result = {
        "instance_id": instance_id,
        "repo_path": repo_path,
        "buggy_file": buggy_file,
        "buggy_function": buggy_function,
        "inter_procedural": False,
        "extraction_method": "none",
        "call_graph": [],
        "dataflow_paths": [],
        "extraction_time_s": 0.0,
        "error": None,
    }

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="structfuse_") as tmpdir:
        db_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "codeql_db")
        cg_csv = os.path.join(tmpdir, "call_graph.csv")
        df_csv = os.path.join(tmpdir, "dataflow.csv")

        # Phase 1a: CodeQL database + call graph
        codeql_ok = False
        if create_codeql_database(repo_path, db_path, timeout=codeql_timeout):
            if run_codeql_query(
                db_path, str(CALL_GRAPH_QL), cg_csv,
                buggy_function, buggy_file, codeql_timeout, codeql_ram,
            ):
                call_graph = parse_call_graph_csv(cg_csv)
                reachable_files = len({r["file_path"] for r in call_graph})

                if reachable_files >= min_reachable_files:
                    # Phase 1b: bounded data-flow
                    if run_codeql_query(
                        db_path, str(DATAFLOW_QL), df_csv,
                        buggy_function, buggy_file, codeql_timeout, codeql_ram,
                    ):
                        dataflow_paths = parse_dataflow_csv(df_csv)
                        result["call_graph"] = call_graph
                        result["dataflow_paths"] = dataflow_paths
                        result["inter_procedural"] = True
                        result["extraction_method"] = "codeql"
                        codeql_ok = True
                    else:
                        log.warning(
                            "%s: data-flow query failed/timed out, falling back",
                            instance_id,
                        )
                else:
                    log.info(
                        "%s: only %d reachable files (min %d), falling back",
                        instance_id, reachable_files, min_reachable_files,
                    )

        # Beniget fallback
        if not codeql_ok:
            log.info("%s: using Beniget fallback", instance_id)
            beniget_result = beniget_extract(repo_path, buggy_file, buggy_function)
            result["call_graph"] = beniget_result["call_graph"]
            result["dataflow_paths"] = beniget_result["dataflow_paths"]
            result["inter_procedural"] = False
            result["extraction_method"] = "beniget"

    result["extraction_time_s"] = round(time.time() - start, 2)
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="StructFuse Stage 1: extract data-flow features per repo"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repos-file", required=True, help="JSON list of instances")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True, help="Output directory for JSONL")
    parser.add_argument("--num-workers", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--codeql-timeout", type=int, default=300, help="Seconds")
    parser.add_argument("--codeql-ram", type=int, default=8192, help="MB")
    parser.add_argument("--min-reachable-files", type=int, default=5)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    with open(args.repos_file) as f:
        instances = json.load(f)
    log.info("Loaded %d instances", len(instances))

    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    task_args = [
        (inst, args.codeql_timeout, args.codeql_ram, args.min_reachable_files)
        for inst in instances
    ]

    results: list[dict] = []
    if args.num_workers <= 1:
        for ta in task_args:
            r = process_repo(ta)
            if r:
                results.append(r)
    else:
        with Pool(processes=args.num_workers) as pool:
            for r in pool.imap_unordered(process_repo, task_args):
                if r:
                    results.append(r)

    # Write per-instance JSONL
    merged_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "all.jsonl")
    with open(merged_path, "w") as fout:
        for r in results:
            fout.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    # Statistics
    total = len(results)
    codeql_count = sum(1 for r in results if r["extraction_method"] == "codeql")
    beniget_count = sum(1 for r in results if r["extraction_method"] == "beniget")
    failed_count = sum(1 for r in results if r["extraction_method"] == "none")
    avg_time = sum(r["extraction_time_s"] for r in results) / max(total, 1)
    inter_proc = sum(1 for r in results if r["inter_procedural"])

    log.info("=" * 60)
    log.info("Extraction complete: %d instances", total)
    log.info("  CodeQL success:  %d (%.1f%%)", codeql_count, 100 * codeql_count / max(total, 1))
    log.info("  Beniget fallback:%d (%.1f%%)", beniget_count, 100 * beniget_count / max(total, 1))
    log.info("  Failed:          %d (%.1f%%)", failed_count, 100 * failed_count / max(total, 1))
    log.info("  Inter-procedural:%d (%.1f%%)", inter_proc, 100 * inter_proc / max(total, 1))
    log.info("  Avg time/repo:   %.1fs", avg_time)
    log.info("  Output: %s", merged_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
StructFuse Stage 1: Data-flow extraction pipeline.

For each repo, runs CodeQL 2-phase analysis (call graph + bounded data-flow),
falls back to Beniget for intra-file def-use when CodeQL times out or has
insufficient coverage. Outputs JSON Lines with per-instance features.

Input:  JSON file with list of {repo_path, buggy_file, buggy_function}
Output: JSONL files in output_dir, one per repo, plus merged all.jsonl

Dependencies: codeql CLI on PATH, beniget (pip install beniget)
"""

import argparse
import json
import logging
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from multiprocessing import Pool
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import ast

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s",
)
log = logging.getLogger("extract_dataflow")

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CALL_GRAPH_QL = SCRIPT_DIR / "codeql_queries" / "call_graph.ql"
DATAFLOW_QL = SCRIPT_DIR / "codeql_queries" / "bounded_dataflow.ql"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CodeQL helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_codeql_database(repo_path: str, db_path: str, timeout: int) -> bool:
    """Create a CodeQL database for a Python repo. Returns True on success."""
    cmd = [
        "codeql", "database", "create", db_path,
        "--language=python",
        "--source-root", repo_path,
        "--overwrite",
        "--threads=0",  # use all available cores
    ]
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=True
        )
        return True
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:
        log.warning("CodeQL database creation failed for %s: %s", repo_path, e)
        return False


def run_codeql_query(
    db_path: str,
    query_path: str,
    output_csv: str,
    buggy_function: str,
    buggy_file: str,
    timeout: int,
    ram: int,
) -> bool:
    """Run a CodeQL query with external predicates. Returns True on success."""
    output_bqrs = output_csv + ".bqrs"
    run_cmd = [
        "codeql", "query", "run",
        "--database", db_path,
        "--output", output_bqrs,
        f"--ram={ram}",
        f"--timeout={timeout}",
        f"--external=buggyFunctionName={buggy_function}",
        f"--external=buggyFileName={buggy_file}",
        "--threads=0",
        query_path,
    ]
    decode_cmd = [
        "codeql", "bqrs", "decode",
        "--format=csv",
        "--output", output_csv,
        output_bqrs,
    ]
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            run_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout + 60, check=True
        )
        subprocess.run(
            decode_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, check=True
        )
        return True
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:
        log.warning("CodeQL query failed (%s): %s", query_path, e)
        return False


def parse_call_graph_csv(csv_path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse call_graph.ql CSV output into list of function records."""
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("target_func"):
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 6:
                results.append({
                    "target_func": parts[0],
                    "hop_distance": int(parts[1]),
                    "direction": parts[2],
                    "file_path": parts[3],
                    "start_line": int(parts[4]),
                    "end_line": int(parts[5]),
                })
    return results


def parse_dataflow_csv(csv_path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse bounded_dataflow.ql CSV output into list of flow records."""
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("source_file"):
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 7:
                results.append({
                    "source_file": parts[0],
                    "source_func": parts[1],
                    "source_line": int(parts[2]) if parts[2].isdigit() else 0,
                    "sink_file": parts[3],
                    "sink_func": parts[4],
                    "sink_line": int(parts[5]) if parts[5].isdigit() else 0,
                    "path_length": int(parts[6]) if parts[6].isdigit() else 1,
                })
    return results


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Path normalization
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def resolve_file_in_repo(repo_path: str, target_file: str) -> str | None:
    """Resolve a file path against a repo, handling src/ prefix mismatches."""
    candidate = os.path.join(repo_path, target_file)
    if os.path.exists(candidate):
        return target_file

    basename = os.path.basename(target_file)
    best_match = None
    best_suffix_len = 0
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(repo_path):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".") and d != "__pycache__"]
        for f in files:
            if f == basename:
                rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), repo_path)
                if rel.endswith(target_file):
                    return rel
                suffix_len = _common_suffix_length(rel, target_file)
                if suffix_len > best_suffix_len:
                    best_suffix_len = suffix_len
                    best_match = rel
    return best_match


def _common_suffix_length(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    a_parts = a.split("/")
    b_parts = b.split("/")
    count = 0
    for ap, bp in zip(reversed(a_parts), reversed(b_parts)):
        if ap == bp:
            count += 1
        else:
            break
    return count


def normalize_path(path: str, all_py_files: list[str]) -> str:
    """Map a path to its canonical form in all_py_files via suffix matching."""
    if path in all_py_files:
        return path
    for f in all_py_files:
        if f.endswith("/" + path) or path.endswith("/" + f):
            return f
    basename = os.path.basename(path)
    candidates = [f for f in all_py_files if os.path.basename(f) == basename]
    if len(candidates) == 1:
        return candidates[0]
    path_parts = path.split("/")
    best, best_score = path, 0
    for f in candidates:
        score = _common_suffix_length(f, path)
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best = f
    return best if best_score > 0 else path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Beniget fallback
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def beniget_extract(repo_path: str, buggy_file: str, buggy_function: str) -> dict:
    """
    Intra-file def-use chain extraction via beniget.
    Returns a dict with call_graph (empty) and dataflow_paths (intra-file only).
    """
    try:
        import beniget
    except ImportError:
        log.error("beniget not installed; pip install beniget")
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    resolved = resolve_file_in_repo(repo_path, buggy_file)
    if resolved:
        buggy_file = resolved
    target_path = os.path.join(repo_path, buggy_file)
    if not os.path.exists(target_path):
        log.warning("Buggy file not found: %s", target_path)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    try:
        with open(target_path) as f:
            source = f.read()
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=buggy_file)
    except SyntaxError:
        log.warning("SyntaxError parsing %s", target_path)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    duc = beniget.DefUseChains()
    duc.visit(tree)

    # Build def-use edges within the buggy file
    dataflow_paths = []
    buggy_func_node = None
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            if node.name == buggy_function:
                buggy_func_node = node
                break

    if buggy_func_node is None:
        log.warning("Function %s not found in %s", buggy_function, buggy_file)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    # Collect all names defined in the buggy function and trace their uses
    for node in ast.walk(buggy_func_node):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            try:
                chain = duc.chains[node]
            except KeyError:
                continue
            for user in chain.users():
                user_node = user.node
                dataflow_paths.append({
                    "source_file": buggy_file,
                    "source_func": buggy_function,
                    "source_line": getattr(node, "lineno", 0),
                    "sink_file": buggy_file,
                    "sink_func": _enclosing_function_name(tree, user_node),
                    "sink_line": getattr(user_node, "lineno", 0),
                    "path_length": 1,
                })

    # Deduplicate
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for p in dataflow_paths:
        key = (p["source_func"], p["source_line"], p["sink_func"], p["sink_line"])
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(p)

    return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": unique}


def _enclosing_function_name(tree: ast.AST, node: ast.AST) -> str:
    """Find the name of the function enclosing `node`, or '<module>'."""
    # Build parent map
    parent_map: dict[ast.AST, ast.AST] = {}
    for parent in ast.walk(tree):
        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(parent):
            parent_map[child] = parent
    current = node
    while current in parent_map:
        current = parent_map[current]
        if isinstance(current, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            return current.name
    return "<module>"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-repo processing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def process_repo(args_tuple: tuple) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """
    Process a single repo: CodeQL extraction with Beniget fallback.
    Called by multiprocessing pool.
    """
    instance, codeql_timeout, codeql_ram, min_reachable_files = args_tuple
    repo_path = instance["repo_path"]
    buggy_file = instance["buggy_file"]
    buggy_function = instance["buggy_function"]
    instance_id = instance.get("instance_id", os.path.basename(repo_path))

    log.info("Processing %s: %s in %s", instance_id, buggy_function, buggy_file)
    start = time.time()

    result = {
        "instance_id": instance_id,
        "repo_path": repo_path,
        "buggy_file": buggy_file,
        "buggy_function": buggy_function,
        "inter_procedural": False,
        "extraction_method": "none",
        "call_graph": [],
        "dataflow_paths": [],
        "extraction_time_s": 0.0,
        "error": None,
    }

"""
StructFuse Stage 1: Data-flow extraction pipeline.

For each repo, runs CodeQL 2-phase analysis (call graph + bounded data-flow),
falls back to Beniget for intra-file def-use when CodeQL times out or has
insufficient coverage. Outputs JSON Lines with per-instance features.

Input:  JSON file with list of {repo_path, buggy_file, buggy_function}
Output: JSONL files in output_dir, one per repo, plus merged all.jsonl

Dependencies: codeql CLI on PATH, beniget (pip install beniget)
"""

import argparse
import json
import logging
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from multiprocessing import Pool
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import ast

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s",
)
log = logging.getLogger("extract_dataflow")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CodeQL helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_codeql_database(repo_path: str, db_path: str, timeout: int) -> bool:
    """Create a CodeQL database for a Python repo. Returns True on success."""
    cmd = [
        "codeql", "database", "create", db_path,
        "--language=python",
        "--source-root", repo_path,
        "--overwrite",
        "--threads=0",  # use all available cores
    ]
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=True
        )
        return True
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:
        log.warning("CodeQL database creation failed for %s: %s", repo_path, e)
        return False


def run_codeql_query(
    db_path: str,
    query_path: str,
    output_csv: str,
    buggy_function: str,
    buggy_file: str,
    timeout: int,
    ram: int,
) -> bool:
    """Run a CodeQL query with external predicates. Returns True on success."""
    output_bqrs = output_csv + ".bqrs"
    run_cmd = [
        "codeql", "query", "run",
        "--database", db_path,
        "--output", output_bqrs,
        f"--ram={ram}",
        f"--timeout={timeout}",
        f"--external=buggyFunctionName={buggy_function}",
        f"--external=buggyFileName={buggy_file}",
        "--threads=0",
        query_path,
    ]
    decode_cmd = [
        "codeql", "bqrs", "decode",
        "--format=csv",
        "--output", output_csv,
        output_bqrs,
    ]
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            run_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout + 60, check=True
        )
        subprocess.run(
            decode_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, check=True
        )
        return True
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as e:
        log.warning("CodeQL query failed (%s): %s", query_path, e)
        return False


def parse_call_graph_csv(csv_path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse call_graph.ql CSV output into list of function records."""
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("target_func"):
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 6:
                results.append({
                    "target_func": parts[0],
                    "hop_distance": int(parts[1]),
                    "direction": parts[2],
                    "file_path": parts[3],
                    "start_line": int(parts[4]),
                    "end_line": int(parts[5]),
                })
    return results


def parse_dataflow_csv(csv_path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse bounded_dataflow.ql CSV output into list of flow records."""
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("source_file"):
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 7:
                results.append({
                    "source_file": parts[0],
                    "source_func": parts[1],
                    "source_line": int(parts[2]) if parts[2].isdigit() else 0,
                    "sink_file": parts[3],
                    "sink_func": parts[4],
                    "sink_line": int(parts[5]) if parts[5].isdigit() else 0,
                    "path_length": int(parts[6]) if parts[6].isdigit() else 1,
                })
    return results


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Beniget fallback
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def beniget_extract(repo_path: str, buggy_file: str, buggy_function: str) -> dict:
    """
    Intra-file def-use chain extraction via beniget.
    Returns a dict with call_graph (empty) and dataflow_paths (intra-file only).
    """
    try:
        import beniget
    except ImportError:
        log.error("beniget not installed; pip install beniget")
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    target_path = os.path.join(repo_path, buggy_file)
    if not os.path.exists(target_path):
        log.warning("Buggy file not found: %s", target_path)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    try:
        with open(target_path) as f:
            source = f.read()
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=buggy_file)
    except SyntaxError:
        log.warning("SyntaxError parsing %s", target_path)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    duc = beniget.DefUseChains()
    duc.visit(tree)

    # Build def-use edges within the buggy file
    dataflow_paths = []
    buggy_func_node = None
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            if node.name == buggy_function:
                buggy_func_node = node
                break

    if buggy_func_node is None:
        log.warning("Function %s not found in %s", buggy_function, buggy_file)
        return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": []}

    # Collect all names defined in the buggy function and trace their uses
    for node in ast.walk(buggy_func_node):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            try:
                chain = duc.chains[node]
            except KeyError:
                continue
            for user in chain.users():
                user_node = user.node
                dataflow_paths.append({
                    "source_file": buggy_file,
                    "source_func": buggy_function,
                    "source_line": getattr(node, "lineno", 0),
                    "sink_file": buggy_file,
                    "sink_func": _enclosing_function_name(tree, user_node),
                    "sink_line": getattr(user_node, "lineno", 0),
                    "path_length": 1,

    # Deduplicate
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for p in dataflow_paths:
        key = (p["source_func"], p["source_line"], p["sink_func"], p["sink_line"])
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(p)

    return {"call_graph": [], "dataflow_paths": unique}


def _enclosing_function_name(tree: ast.AST, node: ast.AST) -> str:
    """Find the name of the function enclosing `node`, or '<module>'."""
    # Build parent map
    parent_map: dict[ast.AST, ast.AST] = {}
    for parent in ast.walk(tree):
        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(parent):
            parent_map[child] = parent
    current = node
    while current in parent_map:
        current = parent_map[current]
        if isinstance(current, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            return current.name
    return "<module>"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def process_repo(args_tuple: tuple) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """

    Called by multiprocessing pool.
    """
    instance, codeql_timeout, codeql_ram, min_reachable_files = args_tuple

    result["extraction_time_s"] = round(time.time() - start, 2)
    return result

def main():
